actions.text: A loose stone in the floor ahead. Step on it, then keep moving.
A spiked pit fills the middle of this room.
Purple runes glow in the floor. Don't step on them.
Five traps lie between you and the exit. Watch the floor.
You land in a damp cellar and the trapdoor snaps shut above you. There's a ladder to the east.
You climb back out. Walk around the pit this time.
A dart shoots out of the wall and hits you!

else.text: A dart whistles through the spot where you just stood.

dartFires.notes: Fires 1.2 s after the plate. It only hits if the player is still standing on it.

actions.text: Click! The plate sinks under your foot. Move!
The water drains away and the door unlocks.
The water is up to your chin. Pull the lever!
The rune flares and throws you back to the start of the hall.
You beat the gauntlet without a scratch!

else.text: You beat the gauntlet. The hits flag shows how often the traps got you.

actions.text: The door slams behind you and water pours in from the walls! There's a lever on the east wall.
